2]]=function(...)return dispatch(program,child,scope,pack(...),null_value)end elseif op==O.VARARG then regs[ins[2]]=varargs[1]elseif op==O.VARARGM then for i=1,ins[3]do
regs[ins[2]+i-1]=varargs[i]end elseif op==O.ENTER then scope={parent=scope,values={},declared={}}elseif op==O.LEAVE then scope=scope.parent elseif op==O.FORTEST then local
value,limit,step=regs[ins[3]],regs[ins[4]],regs[ins[5]]regs[ins[2]]=(step>=0 and value<=limit)or(step<0 and value>=limit)elseif op==O.FORIN then local iterator,state,
control=regs[ins[3]],regs[ins[4]],regs[ins[5]]local result=pack(iterator(state,control))if result[1]==nil then pc=ins[7]else regs[ins[2]]=result[1]for i=2,ins[6]do regs[
ins[2]+i-1]=result[i]end regs[ins[5]]=result[1]end elseif op==O.RETURN_TREE then local result=eval_call(ins[2],regs,varargs)return unpackf(result,1,result.n)elseif op==O.
RETURN_MIX then local values={};for i=1,ins[3]do values[i]=regs[ins[2]+i-1]end local tail=eval_call(ins[4],regs,varargs)for i=1,tail.n do values[ins[3]+i]=tail[i]end
return unpackf(values,1,ins[3]+tail.n)elseif op==O.RETURN_VARARG then local values={};for i=1,ins[3]do values[i]=regs[ins[2]+i-1]end for i=1,varargs.n do values[ins[3]+i]=
varargs[i]end return unpackf(values,1,ins[3]+varargs.n)elseif op==O.RETURN then local count=ins[3]if count<=0 then return end local values={};for i=1,count do values[i]=
regs[ins[2]+i-1]end return unpackf(values,1,count)else error("PulseVM: invalid opcode "..tostring(op).." at instruction "..tostring(pc-1))end end end do local x1028=100328
;local _pvnoise21a=92828888;local _pvnoise21b=100328;local _pvnoise21n1=72007774;local _pvnoise21n2=63074581;local _pvnoise21n3=20060797;local _pvnoise21n4=27221894;local
_pvnoise21n5=13736254;local _pvnoise21h0=0x3955;local _pvnoise21h1=0x6BBD;local _pvnoise21s={"//","\"","_","';'","x1028","*","++ // ';' ; _ - * \" # `;`","++",";","#",
"`;`"};end local function _nuvm(program,proto_index,parent_scope,argv,null_value)local proto=program.functions[proto_index]local O=VMOPS[8]local scope={parent=parent_scope
,values={},declared={}}local regs,pc={},1 local params=proto.params or{}for i=1,#params do declare(scope,params[i],argv[i])end local varargs={n=math.max(0,(argv.n or#argv)
-#params)}for i=1,varargs.n do varargs[i]=argv[#params+i]end local constants=proto.constants local code=proto.code while true do local ins=code[pc]if not ins then return
end pc=pc+1 local op=ins[1]if op==O.LOADK then local v=constants[ins[3]];if v==null_value then v=nil end;regs[ins[2]]=v elseif op==O.MOVE then regs[ins[2]]=regs[ins[3]]
elseif op==O.GET then regs[ins[2]]=getname(scope,constants[ins[3]])elseif op==O.SET then setname(scope,constants[ins[2]],regs[ins[3]])elseif op==O.DECLARE then declare(
scope,constants[ins[2]],regs[ins[3]])elseif op==O.NEWTABLE then regs[ins[2]]={}elseif op==O.GETTABLE then regs[ins[2]]=regs[ins[3]][regs[ins[4]]]elseif op==O.SETTABLE then
regs[ins[2]][regs[ins[3]]]=regs[ins[4]]elseif op==O.BINARY then regs[ins[2]]=binary(constants[ins[5]],regs[ins[3]],regs[ins[4]])elseif op==O.UNARY then regs[ins[2]]=unary(
constants[ins[4]],regs[ins[3]])elseif op==O.JMP then pc=ins[2]elseif op==O.JMPF then if not truthy(regs[ins[2]])then pc=ins[3]end elseif op==O.CALL then local args={};for
i=1,ins[4]do args[i]=regs[ins[5]+i-1]end local fn=regs[ins[3]]local result=pack(fn(unpackf(args,1,ins[4])))for i=1,ins[6]do regs[ins[2]+i-1]=result[i]end elseif op==O.
CALL_TREE then local result=eval_call(ins[3],regs,varargs)for i=1,ins[4]do regs[ins[2]+i-1]=result[i]end elseif op==O.TAILCALL then local args={};for i=1,ins[3]do args[i]=
regs[ins[4]+i-1]end return regs[ins[2]](unpackf(args,1,ins[3]))elseif op==O.CLOSURE then local child=ins[3]regs[ins[2]]=function(...)return dispatch(program,child,scope,
pack(...),null_value)end elseif op==O.VARARG then regs[ins[2]]=varargs[1]elseif op==O.VARARGM then for i=1,ins[3]do regs[ins[2]+i-1]=varargs[i]end elseif op==O.ENTER then
scope={parent=scope,values={},declared={}}elseif op==O.LEAVE then scope=scope.parent elseif op==O.FORTEST then local value,limit,step=regs[ins[3]],regs[ins[4]],regs[ins[5]
]regs[ins[2]]=(step>=0 and value<=limit)or(step<0 and value>=limit)elseif op==O.FORIN then local iterator,state,control=regs[ins[3]],regs[ins[4]],regs[ins[5]]local result=
pack(iterator(state,control))if result[1]==nil then pc=ins[7]else regs[ins[2]]=result[1]for i=2,ins[6]do regs[ins[2]+i-1]=result[i]end regs[ins[5]]=result[1]end elseif op
==O.RETURN_TREE then local result=eval_call(ins[2],regs,varargs)return unpackf(result,1,result.n)elseif op==O.RETURN_MIX then local values={};for i=1,ins[3]do values[i]=
regs[ins[2]+i-1]end local tail=eval_call(ins[4],regs,varargs)for i=1,tail.n do values[ins[3]+i]=tail[i]end return unpackf(values,1,ins[3]+tail.n)elseif op==O.RETURN_VARARG
then local values={};for i=1,ins[3]do values[i]=regs[ins[2]+i-1]end for i=1,varargs.n do values[ins[3]+i]=varargs[i]end return unpackf(values,1,ins[3]+varargs.n)elseif op
==O.RETURN then local count=ins[3]if count<=0 then return end local values={};for i=1,count do values[i]=regs[ins[2]+i-1]end return unpackf(values,1,count)else error(
"PulseVM: invalid opcode "..tostring(op).." at instruction "..tostring(pc-1))end end end do local x1028=100328;local _pvnoise23a=92828888;local _pvnoise23b=100328;local
_pvnoise23n1=15795065;local _pvnoise23n2=22804207;local _pvnoise23n3=12013523;local _pvnoise23n4=6985765;local _pvnoise23n5=71459756;local _pvnoise23h0=0xF119;local
_pvnoise23h1=0xC44D;local _pvnoise23s={"++ // ';' ; _ - * \" # `;`","//","-","++","100328","`;`","*","';'","#",";","x1028"};end dispatch=function(program,proto_index,
parent_scope,argv,null_value)local vm=(program.functions[proto_index]and program.functions[proto_index].vm)or 1 if vm==1 then return _nouveaun(program,proto_index,
parent_scope,argv,null_value)end if vm==2 then return _nuvo(program,proto_index,parent_scope,argv,null_value)end if vm==3 then return _nouv3au(program,proto_index,
parent_scope,argv,null_value)end if vm==4 then return _nuveau(program,proto_index,parent_scope,argv,null_value)end if vm==5 then return _nouvx(program,proto_index,
parent_scope,argv,null_value)end if vm==6 then return _nuv0(program,proto_index,parent_scope,argv,null_value)end if vm==7 then return _nouva(program,proto_index,
parent_scope,argv,null_value)end if vm==8 then return _nuvm(program,proto_index,parent_scope,argv,null_value)end error("PulseVM: unknown VM profile "..tostring(vm))end
